study: RxRSI executable co-prescription memory on the registered v27 method panels
registered_before: Any rule-memory optimization or v27 test inference; conventional development scores and in-progress author-method development scores were already observed.
case_order: Nested patient hash order per seed; all eligible visits for each selected patient. This is controlled experience growth, not absolute calendar-time deployment. Full training vocabularies remain fixed for all methods.
policy: At each round refit the shared structured logistic policy using only currently seen training patients. Same features, C grid and proposal threshold selection as conventional controls. Three patient-disjoint cross-fitting folds produce training-error probabilities for rule induction; a case's target is not used to fit the policy predicting that case. All rule arms share these fits/probabilities and the same seen cases.
memory: Typed executable inclusion/exclusion rules. A rule tests one observed input feature and a fixed near-threshold probability band for one ATC-L4 class, then changes that class's membership. Rules cannot access current prescription labels at inference. No free-form rationale, imagined trajectory, novel dose or arbitrary code is executed. Backbone coefficients update by ordinary supervised refitting; only the rule policy is proposed by the language agent.
candidate_generation: Use up to128 most frequent nonzero structured features among currently seen patients. Eligible changes require at least30 affected induction visits from20 patients and positive patient-average Jaccard change. Restrict actions to probabilities within0.15 of the shared threshold. Produce at most24 ADD/DELETE candidates, ranked by measured induction change; deterministic ID order for agent presentation. At most20 retained rules.
witness_gate: A fixed20% of currently seen training patients are excluded from rule induction and used for edit verification, with their probabilities also cross-fitted. Accept an edit only if it changes at least5 witness patients, improves patient-average F1 and does not decrease Jaccard. Reuse across rounds is disclosed; this is training validation, not independent confirmation. No guard/test score selects an edit.

agent.input: Only aggregate typed rule descriptors, affected-patient counts and measured error changes; never individual clinical records, prompts, patient IDs or predictions. The agent selects candidate IDs; unknown/duplicate IDs or malformed responses are rejected and logged.

controls: Greedy and random choose at most4 edits from their own current candidate pools, with the same gate. Shuffled evidence permutes aggregate gain/support fields among candidate descriptors before the agent sees them; the verifier uses actual evidence. Gate ablation applies the verified agent's same proposed IDs without its gate and does not claim an independent feedback trajectory. Uniform policy has no rules. Extra proposal/search costs are disclosed, not called equal FLOPs.
selection: Save all raw/accepted memory states, sources, proposals and hashes per round. Proposal patient-average Jaccard selects final round per arm (earliest tie). Guard is report-only. Test all selected states and all frozen round curves only after every author model and RxRSI seed/panel selection is frozen. Never select repairs from test scores.
ablations: At the selected own-error round, remove its memory without retuning; replace its memory with its earliest-round memory; replace its policy with its first-round policy while retaining selected memory. Report changed-object hashes and exact budgets. These are interventions, not separately optimized methods.
main_endpoints: Same patient-average F1/Jaccard, micro metrics, set sizes, OOV and zero-target strata, known-graph DDI/coverage and patient-paired intervals as the registered panel. Report three-seed variation and paired differences versus uniform, greedy and shuffled controls, including regressions.
claim_boundary: Statistical co-prescription memory is not a clinical guideline or demonstrated human-like reasoning. This class-set task does not generate dosage orders. An LLM choosing rule edits does not make the shared supervised coefficient updates autonomous weight evolution. Prior observed-test overlap remains exploratory. The strongest author/conventional baseline remains in the main table regardless of outcome.
